headline: Wall Street Crash Puts Australian Equities Under Pressure
summary: A sharp Friday sell-off on Wall Street sent U.S. markets into correction territory. The decline is expected to put Australia's ASX index under pressure.
why: U.S. stock indices serve as benchmark indicators for global financial markets. Major sell-offs in New York frequently trigger spillover declines in Asian and Australian equities.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: Wall Street sell-off exerts immediate downward pressure on Australian benchmark equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A severe drop in U.S. equities dampened global investor sentiment and led to lower opens across Asia-Pacific stock exchanges.
